Specifications

Ather 450 Apex spec sheet

Manufacturer figures. Range is IDC-tested; real-world range in Chennai traffic is lower.

Ather 450 Apex specifications
Peak power7 kW
Torque26 Nm
0 – 40 km/h2.9 s (Warp+)
Top speed100 km/h
Battery3.5 kWh
IDC range165 km
TrueRange130 km
Charging0–80% in 3 hr 25 min · 0–100% in 4 hr 30 min (900 W)
Fast chargeUp to 30 km in 10 min on Ather Grid
Kerb weight111.6 kg
Brakes200 mm triple-piston disc front / 190 mm disc rear, CBS
Dashboard17.7 cm (7") TFT touchscreen
NavigationGoogle Maps platform
Cruise controlInfinite Cruise — City Cruise, Hill Control, Crawl Control
SoftwareAtherStack Pro included
Battery warranty3 yr / 30,000 km standard · extendable up to 10 yr / 1,00,000 km

Best for: Riders who want the quickest scooter on the road and will actually use the performance.
